docs.title: FlowBeast
docs.text:
AI-powered short-form drama content generation engine

FlowBeast is an AI-powered short-form drama content generation engine. The core pipeline is: Topic → Viral Script (JSON) → Audio → Video-ready output.

docs.title: Quick Links
docs.text:
• 📚 Getting Started
  • 🏗️ Architecture

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• 🎬 Drama Generation: AI-driven short drama script generation
  • 🧬 FP3 Knowledge Base: RAG-powered viral pattern injection
  • 🎙️ Audio Generation: TTS-powered voice synthesis
  • 🎥 Video Pipeline: End-to-end video generation

docs.title: Project Structure
docs.text:
FlowBeast/
├── flowbeast/          # Core package
├── docs/              # MkDocs documentation

└── tests/             # Test suite

docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
# Install dependencies
uv sync

# Run the drama generation pipeline
python main.py

# Run the FastAPI server
uvicorn flowbeast.api.main:app --reload --port 8000

# Initialize FP3 vector knowledge base
python -m scripts.init_fp3

# Run tests
uv run pytest tests/ -q

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text: FlowBeast consists of two core engines working together:

docs.title: IP2 — Drama Generation Layer (flowbeast/drama/)
docs.text: Generates viral short-drama scripts via LLM calls.

docs.title: FP3 — Viral Gene Knowledge Base (flowbeast/fp3/)
docs.text: RAG layer that enriches prompts with retrieved viral patterns.

docs.title: LLM Routing (flowbeast/core/config.py)
docs.text: Provider Model API Key Gemini gemini-1.5-flash GOOGLE_API_KEY Qwen qwen-plus DASHSCOPE_API_KEY OpenAI gpt-4o OPENAI_API_KEY

docs.title: Key Data Structures
docs.text:
# drama/schema.py
Script: title, genre, core_hook, scenes: List[Scene]
Scene: id, hook, conflict, emotion_curve, dialogue: List[Dialogue]

# fp3/schema.py
ViralUnit: hook: str, pattern: str, emotion: List[str]

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: Welcome to FlowBeast! This guide will help you get up and running quickly.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Python 3.10+
  • uv package manager
  • API keys for your chosen LLM provider

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/FlowBeast/FlowBeast.git
cd FlowBeast
uv sync

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
Create a .env file in the project root:

ACTIVE_VENDOR=gemini
GOOGLE_API_KEY=your_google_api_key
FLOWBEAST_OUTPUT_DIR=./flowbeast/data/outputs
FLOWBEAST_VECTOR_DIR=./flowbeast/data/vectors

docs.title: First Run
docs.text:
python -m scripts.init_fp3
python main.py --topic "一个关于人工智能的短剧"

docs.text:
• 0001 - FAISS for FP3 (Accepted)
  • 0002 - Unified Embedding Interface (Proposed)

docs.title: Status
docs.text: Accepted

docs.title: Context
docs.text: FP3 subsystem needs a vector database for RAG functionality.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text: Use FAISS as the vector storage backend.

docs.title: Positive
docs.text:
• Zero dependency deployment
  • Millisecond-level retrieval

docs.title: Negative
docs.text:
• Memory intensive
  • No distributed support

docs.title: Status
docs.text: Proposed

docs.title: Context
docs.text: Current embedding implementation has vendor-specific code duplication.

docs.title: Decision
docs.text: Create unified EmbeddingClient interface.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
• Single responsibility
  • Easier testing
  • Better extensibility

FlowBeast 是一个 AI 驱动的短视频内容生成引擎。核心流程是：选题 → 病毒剧本 (JSON) → 音频 → 视频成品。

docs.text: FlowBeast 由两个核心引擎协同工作：

docs.title: IP2 — 剧本生成层 (flowbeast/drama/)

docs.text: RAG 层，通过检索到的病毒模式来增强 prompt。

docs.title: 上下文
docs.text: FP3 子系统需要一个向量数据库来支持 RAG 功能。

docs.title: 决策
docs.text: 选用 FAISS 作为 FP3 的向量存储后端。

docs.title: 正面

• 零依赖部署

docs.text:
• 内存占用大
  • 不支持分布式

docs.title: 0002 - 统一 Embedding 接口设计
上下文
docs.text: 当前 embedding 实现有供应商特定代码重复。

docs.title: 决策
docs.text: 创建统一的 EmbeddingClient 接口。

docs.title: 后果
docs.text:
• 单一职责
  • 易于测试
  • 更好的扩展性
